text:
alex: Heads up: CI started failing intermittently with "coroutine was never awaited" and "Task was destroyed but it is pending" when running our test suite under uvloop.

alex: Minimal pattern: sync helper constructs sdk.Client() which spins a background async httpx client. Tests are async via pytest-asyncio and don't close the client explicitly.

mina: That pattern is fragile. Library should provide an explicit AsyncClient with __aenter__/__aexit__ so tests can use async fixtures.

jasper: Also seeing type confusion in IDEs when switching to AsyncClient. We should expose clear overloads and examples in the README.

alex: Sample failure in CI: 
```
RuntimeWarning: coroutine 'AsyncClient.aclose' was never awaited
Task was destroyed but it is pending!
RuntimeError: Event loop is closed
```

doc-bot: Please see docs/async_clients.md (suggested edits)

mina: Action items: add AsyncClient class, add an anyio.from_thread safe close_sync(), avoid scheduling cleanup tasks in __del__, add a RuntimeWarning instructing explicit close.

jasper: I'll open a PR with typing changes (overloads + __all__ exports) and tests that run under uvloop to catch regressions.

alex: For now test workaround: use an async pytest fixture that does `async with sdk.AsyncClient() as c: yield c`.

mina: Filing DEX ticket: DEX-456. Tagging @eng-ml for review since this impacts inference tests.

jasper: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2278 (draft). CI: flaky-async/uvloop job failing intermittently.

alex: Thanks. Let's keep this small and land the safe close first. :thumbsup:
